newsitem.title: USA: US spot jet fuel prices edge higher in thin trade.
newsitem.headline: US spot jet fuel prices edge higher in thin trade.

text.p: U.S. spot jet fuel prices edged slightly higher on Monday amid a slight firming in NYMEX values and stable differentials in the Gulf Coast and New York Harbor, players said.
Prompt NYH 54-grade jet fuel was offered for 1.75 cents above July futures, with Gulf material offered at 0.20 cent below the screen.
"There's no movement in differentials on the rest of the distillate barrel either," New York player said, describing continued range-bound trading.
